question: Oda-sensei, I have a question for you. When did you decide to become a manga artist? And what did you do to achieve that goal? Please tell us.
answer: First off, I decided to become a manga artist when I was four years old. The moment I learned that being a manga artist was an actual job in this world, I thought, “Then I won't have to work when I grow up!” and that's when I decided. But I didn't really start drawing seriously until around my second year of junior high school. As for what I did to get there... I doodled. Even now, I doodle in my sketchbook while thinking up stories.
